name: round3_bcde
description: Families B-E only, for the re-run on the CORRECTED subscriber configuration. Family A is deliberately absent: run it first via -Stage calibration, read the new ceiling and apply knee, retarget B and E from them, then run this.
notes: Why this file exists rather than 'campaign.json --resume':
supervisor.py keys its resume checkpoint on the campaign NAME.
'round3_full', so --resume on campaign.json finds no checkpoint for
'round3_full', logs 'starting fresh', and re-runs family A - about 50
minutes of load for a result you already have. Splitting the campaign
removes the question instead of documenting it.
--resume still works WITHIN this campaign if it is interrupted.
